approved_design: carbon_research_reassessment_20261015_ZH.md; finite optimization details specified here before first scores

data.features: 60 price increments only; no source row/date-format attributes

model.boundary: truncated backward means within the same 60-step input
model.context: previous increment, previous up-to-5 increment mean, previous up-to-20 squared increment mean; first position zeros
model.dynamic_router: softmax([A q+b,0]); A is 2x3, b is length 2
model.encoder: two independent GRU(1,10) encoders plus Linear(20,20)
model.forecast: current price plus train-scaled 20-dimensional net-change output

support.origins: max(60,end-20-480) through end-21 inclusive; every target <=end-1
support.C: last 60 mature origins for internal checkpoint selection
support.F: all origins before that purge; final theta uses F
support.A_B: let n=len(F), a=floor(.65*(n-20)); A=F[:a], gap=F[a:a+20], B=F[a+20:]
support.router_pool: A union B only; equal labeled support available to both router-learning rules
support.scale: standard deviation of 60-increment windows in A only, floor 1e-6, fixed for all modes in this refit

learning.warmup: 20 full-batch AdamW theta-only steps on A with zero router; lr .003, weight_decay .001, norm clip 1; identical initialization per seed/block across factorial modes
learning.TEMP: 40 iterations. One differentiable clipped SGD theta step on A, eta .01. Exact derivative of B MSE at that provisional theta plus .001*||phi||^2 with respect to phi, including mixed derivative through inner step. Adam phi lr .03, no optimizer weight decay, norm clip 1, box projection. Carry provisional theta forward detached; truncate derivatives through previous outer iterations. No C or outer-score checkpoint selection of phi.
learning.ERM: 120 ordinary joint steps on A union B, theta SGD lr .01; phi Adam lr .03; same .001 router penalty and norm/box controls. This gives ordinary controls a conservative larger first-order update allowance, not a claim of exactly equal FLOPs.
learning.final_fit: Freeze learned phi for all four factorial modes. Reset theta to same original seeded initialization. Fit all F with AdamW lr .003, weight_decay .001, max 200 epochs, norm clip 1, C patience 20 and improvement tolerance 1e-6; step zero eligible. No state from router-learning theta is transferred.
learning.D_JOINT: additional ordinary end-to-end baseline: dynamic router and identical dual GRU, max 340 joint AdamW steps on F, router penalty .001, C patience20, step zero eligible; not another innovation candidate
learning.GRU: ordinary GRU(1,16)+Linear(16,20), 1252 parameters; same F/C/scaler, max340 AdamW steps, same patience; no decomposition
learning.loss: mean squared standardized original-price net-change errors across all 20 horizons; does not replace labels with smoothed components
learning.hyperparameter_search: none beyond internal C checkpoint selection; one fixed configuration per mode
learning.budget_records: actual epochs, forward sample visits, phase times, CPU process time, gradient norms and router motion; no same-step=same-FLOP claim

external_baselines.always: RW; drift windows120/240/480; direct Ridge L5/20 x penalties .001/.01/.1/1; HistGradientBoosting leaves7/15 x learning_rate .05/.1 x window240/480, max_iter80, no random early stopping; previously defined 31-member lowdim ML bank, likelihood windows120/240/480. Fresh forecasts, not reused historical arrays.
external_baselines.conditional_strong_ensemble: Only if factorial mechanism gate passes: newly train/replay four-seed rolling+online GRU fixed and matured-weight ensemble from audited author-project code. Historical .924480 is context, never substituted for fresh paired predictions.
external_baselines.Cstar: best noncandidate among complete predeclared fresh baseline pool on development, include all factorial controls and D_JOINT; historical statistics excluded

metrics.primary: equal mean of 2020/2021 x h1/5/20 MSE(model)/MSE(RW); each origin and all 20 targets inside same year
metrics.seed_mean_loss: primary neural statistic averages losses across 4 seeds before year/h ratios
metrics.ensemble: separate table for mean prediction of same 4 seeds; never mix with mean losses
metrics.also: RMSE and MAE by horizon/year; pooled results descriptive only
metrics.uncertainty: 2000 paired moving-block resamples separately within each year, block lengths20/40/60, same dates/models/horizons; developmental and not corrected for cross-round selection

mechanism_gate: D_TEMP relative primary reduction >=1% versus each of D_ERM and S_TEMP, no worse than S_ERM; positive factorial interaction; wins on >=3/4 paired seed scores against each D_ERM/S_TEMP. Must also improve >=2% versus RW. Otherwise stop without training another candidate, changing settings or reading later years.
prediction_gate: Requires mechanism gate and >=1% improvement vs fresh Cstar in mean-seed loss and equal-4-seed ensemble where applicable, no yearly average >1.05 vs RW. Strong rolling/online ensemble must subsequently be faced. Passing development is not publication qualification.
tests_before_scores: nested A/B/C purges and mature targets
deterministic fit replay on synthetic fixture
scope: No new synthetic performance contest; only implementation fixtures. No full-text novelty or future-risk guarantees. No 2022/2023/2024 market reads or scores, no Hubei/EU modeling. Keep every result, failure and source change. New research branch only; no main merge.
source_evidence_this_run: Reviewed latest repository changes and approved report. Rechecked primary abstract records for TMAML and VMDNet and official functional_call documentation; not a new full-text read or original-author code reproduction. Previously quarantined materials not fetched.
